scope: All 16 Ringdown Rust files inventoried; provenance headers and selected implementation/fixture sites inspected. Not a 9,919-line authorship comparison. Original Android artifact was not located in bounded paths.

files.classification: Diagnostic app combining RPC, PacketLogger and offline shared pack export
files.observed_evidence: --audio-pack returns before discovery, but Cargo dependencies on ringdown and ringdown-ble are unconditional.
files.remaining_action: Offline execution is not an artifact exclusion boundary. Verify a future standards-only package dependency closure.

files.classification: Original Rust diagnostic using external PacketLogger format research
files.observed_evidence: Header explicitly credits Wireshark packetlogger.c for facts; public upstream source has GPL-2.0-or-later header. Selected record-reading code compared structurally.
files.remaining_action: No GPL Cargo dependency was found; this does not clear expression provenance. Resolve whether any protectable code was adapted before distributing this diagnostic.

files.classification: HyVibe-specific codec and exact 163-entry wire vocabulary
files.observed_evidence: Static Android class inspection recorded; Rust encoder/decoder sampled; original APK/decompiled source not located for expression comparison.
files.remaining_action: Open: exact necessity/provenance review of dictionary and codec; no clean-room attestation.

files.classification: Public CRC-32/MPEG-2 algorithm selected by instrument-specific observation
files.observed_evidence: Polynomial and compile-time table generation inspected; vendor table is described, generated table is used.
files.remaining_action: Algorithm implementation can be grounded in public CRC sources; this does not standardize other file commands.

files.classification: HyVibe-specific effect names, parameter keys and test settings
files.observed_evidence: Own Rust data model; comments cite owner app UI and hardware findings; one factory-named setting appears in a fixture.
files.remaining_action: Review fixture necessity and avoid publishing factory preset/sample catalogs without rights.

files.observed_evidence: Comments attribute rules to static analysis; contains inherited old-version assumption.
files.remaining_action: Document as vendor profile, not standard BLE handshake; provenance/authenticity gap remains.

files.classification: Standard GATT substrate plus vendor service/characteristic identifiers
files.observed_evidence: Custom eb65... UUIDs and transport exports inspected.
files.remaining_action: UUIDs do not make the service a standard MIDI profile; independent rights review of vendor application layer remains.

files.observed_evidence: Rust Link trait separates OS callbacks from protocol.
files.remaining_action: No vendor SDK dependency declared; full authorship attestation not performed.

files.observed_evidence: Wire keys, sequence/ack rules and static-analysis attribution inspected.
files.remaining_action: JSON syntax is public; chunk semantics remain vendor-specific.

files.observed_evidence: Header fields and attribution to fallback decompiler/instruction inspection read.
files.remaining_action: Wire facts and implementation expression need separate review; compression is not evidence of access-control circumvention.

files.classification: Public RIFF/WAVE with HyVibe JUNK metadata
files.observed_evidence: Parser comments and 92-byte captured header fixture inspected; no audio payload in that fixture.
files.remaining_action: Vendor metadata is not part of generic WAVE; use minimum necessary factual test vectors.

files.classification: Original typed planners over HyVibe methods
files.observed_evidence: Rust request/validation shape and receipt references inspected.
files.remaining_action: Planners inherit vendor-method provenance and cannot be labeled standard MIDI.

files.observed_evidence: Rust retained client state and no-readback rationale inspected.
files.remaining_action: Keep own persistence separate from vendor factory content; no broader provenance certification.

files.classification: Public JSON-RPC envelope with HyVibe methods and permissive version behavior
files.observed_evidence: 32-method vocabulary, numeric outgoing version, string-version acceptance note and captured status fixture inspected.
files.remaining_action: Current output is not strict JSON-RPC 2.0 conformance; review device identifiers in captured fixture before republication.

files.classification: Standard OS/btleplug I/O connected to vendor GATT profile
files.observed_evidence: Discovery and custom UUID selection inspected; btleplug, not a vendor SDK.
files.remaining_action: OS/API/standards licensing scope and platform qualification remain release-specific.

files.classification: Original async session over vendor protocol
files.observed_evidence: Guitar<Link> session, request/ACK handling and imports sampled.
files.remaining_action: Contains HyVibe transports; not a standards-only MIDI driver.
